claim: In a redrive allow policy, which specifies which source queues can access the dead-letter queue, the byQueue option can specify up to 10 source queues, each by its Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

qualifiers.scope: per dead-letter queue redrive allow policy

evidence.quote: The redrive allow policy specifies which source queues can access the dead-letter queue. You can choose whether to allow all source queues, allow specific source queues, or deny all source queues use of the dead-letter queue.
If you choose to allow specific queues using the byQueue option, you can specify up to 10 source queues using the source queue Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
